overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the minutes allegations, since the Board approved each cited set of minutes at its next meeting and the November 2024 joint meeting was not a Board meeting, and declined to review the broad notice-language allegation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to approve minutes in a timely manner for its meetings held January 29, February 12, February 25, March 12, April 16, and April 30, 2025.
allegations.key_passage: Based on a review of the Board’s meeting minutes, the Board approved the minutes of its meetings held on January 29, February 12, February 25, March 12, April 16, and April 30, 2025, at the next meeting following each meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve minutes for a November 19, 2024 joint meeting with the Select Board.
allegations.key_passage: As such, the November 19 meeting was not a meeting of the Board and the Board was not required to create or approve minutes of that meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by adding language referencing G.L. c. 214, § 1B to its meeting notices.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the allegation that the Board added to its meeting notices language related to G.L. c. 214, § 1B.
